dataset_note: First five demonstration records (SAM-02). Collected 2026-10-26 from official pages. Every record is marked needs_recheck or conflicting until Samer opens the source link and confirms it by hand.

opportunities.title: Australian Government Graduate Program - Indigenous Graduate Pathway (Defence as preferred agency)
opportunities.summary: A pathway for First Nations graduates into the public service. Applicants who name Defence as a preferred agency can be placed in one of Defence's graduate pathways, which include ICT and cyber security roles.

eligibility_conditions.text: You must be a First Nations graduate.
eligibility_conditions.evidence_summary: The Defence page says the pathway is for First Nations graduates.

eligibility_conditions.text: To be considered for Defence, you need to list Defence as a preferred agency.
eligibility_conditions.evidence_summary: The page says Defence placement requires Defence to be a preferred agency.

eligibility_conditions.text: Placement depends on your qualifications and area of expertise. The page does not give degree, citizenship or graduation-date rules.
eligibility_conditions.evidence_summary: The page says placement is based on qualifications and expertise and is not guaranteed; no further conditions are listed.

deadline.note: No opening or closing dates and no intake year on this page.

verification.method: Official page read with an automated fetch on this date; not yet confirmed by a person.

opportunities.data_notes: The page does not say who administers the program or give dates. Find the program's own official page before relying on this record. Search results showed more than one defence.gov.au address for this pathway, so confirm which one is current.

opportunities.title: UNSW Cyber Security Scholarship (UGCA1902)
opportunities.provider: UNSW (Bachelor of Cyber Security, UNSW Canberra City Campus)
opportunities.summary: A $5,000 scholarship for students starting the Bachelor of Cyber Security at UNSW Canberra City Campus in Term 1, 2027. It is awarded on academic merit and has no separate application.

eligibility_conditions.text: You must start the Bachelor of Cyber Security at UNSW Canberra City Campus in Term 1, 2027.
eligibility_conditions.evidence_summary: The scholarship page ties the award to commencing this degree, campus and term.

eligibility_conditions.text: You must meet at least one of these: identify as a woman, non-binary or gender-diverse; be Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander; be a former or transitioning Australian Defence Force member; or be a rural applicant (anywhere outside major cities).
eligibility_conditions.evidence_summary: The page lists four groups joined by 'or'. Only one needs to apply. Rural status uses the remoteness classification.

eligibility_conditions.text: You must be an Australian citizen, an Australian permanent resident or a New Zealand citizen.
eligibility_conditions.evidence_summary: The page lists these three residency statuses.

deadline.note: The page gives an opening date of 2026-07-01 but no closing date.

verification.method: Official page read with an automated fetch on this date; not yet confirmed by a person.

opportunities.data_notes: The page shows a status of 'Closed' even though the opening date is 2026-07-01, so the status looks unreliable. It also does not say whether the $5,000 is a total or per year (it says up to 3 years). Open the page and check both before relying on this record.

opportunities.title: 2026 Semester 1 Origin Digital Indigenous Scholarship (Current Students)
opportunities.summary: Up to $10,000 over one year for current Curtin undergraduates in eligible computing, IT and related courses, with possible paid vacation work. The Semester 1, 2026 round has closed.

eligibility_conditions.text: You must be of Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander descent.
eligibility_conditions.evidence_summary: The page lists this as a requirement.

eligibility_conditions.text: You must be an Australian citizen.
eligibility_conditions.evidence_summary: The page lists Australian citizenship as a requirement.

eligibility_conditions.text: You must be a current Curtin student enrolled in at least 75 credits per semester in an eligible undergraduate course.
eligibility_conditions.evidence_summary: The page gives a minimum study load for Semester 1, 2026 and lists the eligible courses.

eligibility_conditions.text: You need a course weighted average of at least 50.
eligibility_conditions.evidence_summary: The page sets a minimum course weighted average.

eligibility_conditions.text: Your course must be on the eligible list, which includes computing, cyber security, software engineering, IT, data science, networking and information systems (and some business and innovation degrees).
eligibility_conditions.evidence_summary: The page lists eligible courses; double degrees count if one degree is listed.

eligibility_conditions.text: You must not receive another scholarship from the same funding source or for the same purpose.
eligibility_conditions.evidence_summary: The page states this as a condition.

deadline.note: Semester 1, 2026 round opened 2026-01-21 and closed 2026-02-25. No later round is announced on the page.

verification.method: Official page read with an automated fetch on this date; not yet confirmed by a person.

opportunities.data_notes: The 'Apply Online' link goes to a general Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander scholarship form, not one specific to this scholarship. It is unclear whether the 75-credit rule applies to Semester 1 only or to every semester.

opportunities.title: School of Cybernetics Scholarship for Indigenous Students
opportunities.summary: $34,000 a year plus up to $20,000 for relocation and cultural support for new Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander students in ANU's Master of Applied Cybernetics programs. There is no separate application; you opt in when applying for the program.

eligibility_conditions.text: You must be a domestic student.
eligibility_conditions.evidence_summary: The page requires domestic student status.

eligibility_conditions.text: You must identify as Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander.
eligibility_conditions.evidence_summary: The page lists this as a requirement.

eligibility_conditions.text: You must be a commencing ANU student with an offer for the Master of Applied Cybernetics or the Master of Applied Cybernetics (Advanced).
eligibility_conditions.evidence_summary: The page names these two programs as the eligible ones.

eligibility_conditions.text: You must keep a full-time study load to keep receiving the award.
eligibility_conditions.evidence_summary: The page states this as an ongoing condition.

deadline.note: The page gives an application period of 2026-04-01 to 2026-10-31.

verification.method: Official page read with an automated fetch on this date; not yet confirmed by a person.

opportunities.data_notes: This is cybernetics, not cyber security, so the team should confirm it is in scope. The page says the award 'may' be offered each year, and it lists the level as Masters and Graduate certificate while naming only the two Masters programs. Check the conditions of award linked from the page.

opportunities.title: Cadetships for Aboriginal & Torres Strait Islander Students (UNE listing)
opportunities.provider: University of New England (Oorala Aboriginal Centre)
opportunities.summary: Paid work-experience placements, usually 12 weeks over summer, with study allowances and mentoring for Indigenous undergraduates. The page does not say which fields or employers are available.

eligibility_conditions.text: You need to be Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander.
eligibility_conditions.evidence_summary: Implied by the page's purpose rather than listed as a formal criterion.

eligibility_conditions.text: You need to be enrolled full-time in an undergraduate degree.
eligibility_conditions.evidence_summary: Implied by the page rather than listed as a formal criterion.

eligibility_conditions.text: The page does not list formal eligibility criteria or which fields are covered.
eligibility_conditions.evidence_summary: No criteria, selection process or field list is given.

deadline.note: No application dates on the page; it points to the Oorala site for current opportunities.

verification.method: Official page read with an automated fetch on this date; not yet confirmed by a person.

opportunities.data_notes: The page appears to have been last updated in November 2021 and refers to a body that may be out of date. It does not say whether IT or cyber placements exist. Confirm with Oorala before relying on it. This record is useful for testing missing-information handling.
